name: naksha-stats-report-explains-costs
prompt: /naksha-stats --since 2026-10-01 (transcripts show /design-reel 2 runs $3.10, /design-score 6 runs $1.20, /pipeline 1 run $2.40, unattributed $0.90; cache reads are 70% of tokens; one model 'claude-unknown-9' is unpriced; 2 malformed lines skipped)
expected_output: Runs the local stats script, shows the per-command table with totals, explains the token kinds and the estimate in plain words, flags /design-reel as the most expensive per run, and suggests cheaper options

assertions.name: runs-script
assertions.description: runs scripts/naksha-stats.js (with --json and the --since flag passed through) rather than estimating costs itself

assertions.name: table-with-totals
assertions.description: shows a table with command, runs, input, output, cache write, cache read and est. $ columns, plus a TOTAL row

assertions.name: plain-explanation
assertions.description: explains in plain words what cache reads are, and says the figures are estimates at API list prices, not an invoice

assertions.name: flags-expensive
assertions.description: names /design-reel as the most expensive command per run (about $1.55 per run)

assertions.name: honest-caveats
assertions.description: says the unpriced model counts as $0, gives the unattributed share, and mentions the 2 skipped lines

assertions.name: grounded-suggestions
assertions.description: gives at most three cheaper options tied to the data (e.g. iterate with /design before one reel, a fresh session because cache reads dominate) without inventing command flags

name: naksha-stats-set-budget
expected_output: Saves a $20 monthly budget, merges a $1.50 per-run /design-reel budget with the existing /pipeline one, sets warn_at 0.75, and emits one naksha-memory-update block per path

assertions.name: monthly-block
assertions.description: emits a naksha-memory-update project_json_patch block for budgets.monthly_usd with the bare number 20

assertions.name: merged-per-command
assertions.description: the budgets.per_command_usd block holds the full merged object, keeping /pipeline: 3 and adding /design-reel: 1.5

assertions.name: warn-fraction
assertions.description: converts 75% to warn_at 0.75 (a number, not a string)

assertions.name: updated-at
assertions.description: emits an updatedAt block with an ISO timestamp

assertions.name: shows-before-saving
assertions.description: shows what will be saved before the memory blocks, which come at the end of the response

name: naksha-stats-budget-requires-init
expected_output: Rejects the negative amount and, because there is no project memory, tells the user to run /naksha-init first; no memory blocks

assertions.name: rejects-negative
assertions.description: rejects -5 as a budget and explains that it must be positive

assertions.name: points-to-init
assertions.description: says there is no project memory and suggests /naksha-init

assertions.name: no-write
assertions.description: emits no naksha-memory-update block

assertions.name: no-file-created
assertions.description: does not create .naksha/project.json itself

name: design-reel-budget-preflight-warning
prompt: /design-reel pricing page (project.json budgets: monthly_usd 20, warn_at 0.8; naksha-stats --budget-check prints 'naksha budget: WARN: 2026-10 spend $17.40 is 87% of the $20.00 monthly budget (warning at 80%)')
expected_output: Runs the budget pre-check before starting, shows the WARN line, and asks whether to continue before running /design or rendering

assertions.name: runs-precheck
assertions.description: runs naksha-stats.js --budget-check --command /design-reel before Step 1

assertions.name: shows-warning
assertions.description: shows the 87% of $20 monthly budget warning to the user

assertions.name: asks-before-starting
assertions.description: asks whether to continue and does not start the /design pass or rendering before the user answers

assertions.name: not-blocking
assertions.description: treats the budget as a warning the user can override, not a hard block

name: pipeline-budget-preflight-quiet-when-ok
prompt: /pipeline run launch-prep "redesign checkout" (project.json budgets: monthly_usd 50; naksha-stats --budget-check prints 'naksha budget: OK — 2026-10 spend $6.10 of $50.00 (12%)')
expected_output: Shows the normal pipeline plan and confirmation prompt without any budget warning, because spend is under warn_at

assertions.name: runs-precheck
assertions.description: runs naksha-stats.js --budget-check --command /pipeline during Phase 1

assertions.name: no-noise
assertions.description: does not show a budget warning or extra budget commentary when only OK lines are printed

assertions.name: normal-confirmation
assertions.description: still displays the plan and asks for confirmation before running steps
